messages:
Ivy R: quick thought — propose a compact 'unit-econ microcard' in the rollout rail that shows: Effective tokens, Amortized cache credit (30m window), and a tiny 'spillover ratio'. one glance tells you if routing/quota caused cost to leak.
Ben C: ooo. "spillover ratio" = % of requests that fell back to cheaper routing vs sticky origin? need a clear def.
Ivy R: yeah: spillover_ratio = (requests_routed_off_primary / total_requests) in the interval. high ratio + high effective tokens = quota spill.
Theo M: backend reality: we emit per-request tokens & kv_hit bools, and we have route_reroute events. to compute amortized cache credit we need to estimate prefetch credit lifetime (30m default). could compute rolling-window credit_consumed and amortize across requests in window. doable in rollup job but a bit heavier.
Ben C: sampling thought: use epochal summaries (1m rollups) and keep a 30-slot sliding buffer to compute amortized credit. avoids per-request joins.
Ivy R: nice. also need to surface provenance: sample_rate, amort_window, calc_version. UI should flag when sample_count < 100 with "low-confidence".
Theo M: attribution edge: shared cache keys across routes and credit pooling will break naive amortization. two options: 1) attribute pool-first (all savings go to pool) or 2) prorate by first-touch. for microcard v1, default to pool-first but show a small toggle in the panel.
Ben C: pool-first is simplest for billing-avoidance but might mask route inefficiencies. ensure the panel explains tradeoffs.
Ivy R: UX: card primary line: "12.3k eff tokens (est)" beneath: "amortized cache credit: 2.1k | spillover: 14%" tiny info opens panel with math: "eff = gross - amortized_cache_credit; amortized_cache_credit = sum(prefetch_credit_consumed in window) / window_requests * attribution_factor". keep it terse.
Theo M: rollout plan: feature-flag -> staging dogfood -> dark-launch 5% org. validate by nightly batch recon to compute median_error. if median_error > 20% for 24h increase sampling for affected routes.
Ben C: runbook snippet: if microcard jumps but billing flat -> 1) check amort_window and sample_rate in provenance panel 2) check spillover_ratio and recent reroute events 3) run offline recon endpoint `/ops/cost/recon?route=...&window=30m` 4) if shared_cache_flag true, run per-key attribution tool.
Ivy R: can we emit a tiny telemetry metric `microcard.low_confidence_count` so product sees how often the value is shaky?
Theo M: yes. also `microcard.spillover_alert` when spillover_ratio > 50% and eff_tokens > threshold.
Ben C: i'll open the front-end PR for the card and panel copy. Theo — backend rollup ticket?
Theo M: on it. I'll implement 1m rollup + 30-slot sliding amortization buffer and emit `gross_tokens`, `amortized_cache_credit`, `spillover_ratio`, `sample_count`, `calc_version`, `shared_cache_flag`.
ops-bot: scheduled canary deploy for branch "eng/unit-econ-microcard" to staging at 2024-11-05T09:00:00Z :rocket:
Ivy R: awesome. i'll draft the panel copy and add the doc explaining pool vs prorate attribution. leaving thread open for PR links. :seedling:
